description: The pull requests of the shown space, grouped by what each one waits for, with a page for each one (description, conversation, checks, files and details), a right-click menu, a filter that hides the merged ones and an agent review. Needs gh. Based on Herdr Ranch.

credit.text: Based on Herdr Ranch by Jelle Slowack (MIT license).

settings.label: Page
settings.hint: Where a pull request opens. Overlay: in a dialog over the window. Split: under the list. Full: in the place of the list.

settings.label: Hide merged
settings.hint: Leaves the merged pull requests out of the list. The Hide merged chip next to the filters changes it too.

settings.label: Shortcut
settings.hint: Opens the Pull Requests window. Saved in keys.json.
